outcome: duration of active phase of labour
cohort: Women delivering at the Obstetrics & Gynaecology department of a medical college hospital in central India were included in this study.
finding: The WHO labour care guide significantly reduced the caesarean delivery rate (5.0%) compared to the modified Partograph group (20.4%).
mod_finding: The WHO labour care guide was associated with a statistically significant reduction in primary caesarean delivery rate.
